files.why: Fitting script. It writes the week5m_/week1m_/moh_ tables, hol_cash_mult, prior sigmas and wknd_ou_kappa into agent/calibration_params.npz (--out, line 442). Journal: iter 1, iter 2, iter 5 and final refit step 2 (--train-end 2026-11-08). Most other research scripts import its ALL_ASSETS and load_1m_closes.

Fitting script. It writes the LOEO-validated ev5m_*/ev1m_* event kernels and the earnings continuation scalars into agent/calibration_params.npz (lines 361-385). Journal: iter 4 and final refit step 3. CHAMPION item 2.

T4 training script for the mlpeq24 Direct-CRPS residual MLP. CHAMPION item 4, journal iter 6 and final refit step 4 (--only-comps mlpeq24). It writes the heads npz that merge_gpu_heads.py merges, and several later scripts import it.
Merges the kept mlpeq24_* arrays from the heads npz into agent/calibration_params.npz (journal line 214, --only defaults to mlpeq24). The served MLP weights come from here.

Leave-One-Event-Out QLIKE/CRPS study of the event-kernel families. It is behind the LOEO inclusion rule cited in CHAMPION item 2, report.md section 'Layer 2' and journal iter 4. The docs do not name the script.
CRPS sweep over 1,662 pre/post-event prompts. It fixed _EVENT_EXCESS_SCALE_5M/_1M at 1.00 (modeling.py:61-64). Journal line 148.
Calibration of the Student-t and AR(1) stochastic-volatility parameters (nu, tau_vov, hl_steps, rho_lev, c_scale), which are hardcoded at modeling.py:974-994. Journal line 108 (iter 3).

Iter 2 study of the Empirical-Bayes session shrinkage and the closed-exchange weekend OU kappa. It is behind _online_session_adjustments and wknd_ou_kappa (journal iter 2, line 74). The docs do not name the script.
Calibration of the multi-scale HAR-EWMA weights and the horizon decay used in the v_short/v_long blends. Journal line 47.
Iter 7 diagnostics and ablations (LHS shocks, the w_gk Garman-Klass hybrid, weekend EB). Journal line 251. Imported by check_eq24_lhs_gpu, tune_iter7_joint_gpu and test_iter8.
Iter 7 joint M=1000 sweep of (nu, tau_vov, hl, c_scale) and w_gk, behind the final shock parameters. Journal line 251. Provides gen_shocks_gpu_v2 to other scripts.
Iter 7 Stage-2C check of COM_EQU_24H LHS with mlpeq24 active, plus the CRYPTO_1H nu bowl. Journal line 251.
Iter 8 residual diagnostic of the weekend and minute-of-hour profiles. It motivated Seasonality v3. Journal line 270.
Iter 8 test of crypto Seasonality v3 (ETF session boundaries, Sunday CME reopen, NYSE holiday dampening). Journal line 275. CHAMPION item 1.
Ablation of spot-anchored against stationary stochastic volatility. It kept the stationary h0 that modeling.py uses. Journal line 204.
Low-DOF CRYPTO_1H head, discarded. Journal line 209; report.md section on discarded GPU heads.

Cell-by-cell comparison of two 3-window prompt parquet sets (54 cells). The docs do not name it, but it produces the 'N/54 cells improved' counts in CHAMPION line 14, report.md and every journal verdict.

The agent's modified backtest driver (multi-competition, --fast-crps, ProcessPool scoring). CHAMPION line 13 cites it for the OOS CRPS figures; also report.md section 5.1 and journal lines 7, 11 and 305.
